title: Delete the editor's nudge/step handler families now that ut-number-field owns the nudge rule
body: AdjustParameterUp/Down, EditProgramFieldUp/Down and NudgeLayerField (3 handler families, 6 trigger rows, per-field step constants kBlendStep/kPrimitiveStep/...) are no longer reached by any panel: the kit element nudges by committing through the value slot. Keep only if a key chord or channel client still needs them. Tier: luna, several files plus the AppFlow schema and regen.

title: Delete ScrubParameter + StepParameterScrub: scrub is the number-field element's now
body: ScrubParameter and EditorApplication::StepParameterScrub (200 px per range, parameters only) are replaced by ut-number-field scrub on every field (one commit on release = one undo entry). Remove handler, trigger, ParameterScrub state. Tier: haiku, one obvious deletion with the existing tests.

title: Collapse the editor's per-array row structs to one shared number-field row
body: EditorParameterRow, EditorTransformRow, EditorShapeFieldRow and EditorLayerRow.blend* repeat label/value/valueId/resetId; upId/downId are now unused by every document. Needs the kernel VIEW emitter to let several arrays share one declared row type (design note section 4 slice 2, sn-liveview1). Tier: sol, kernel emitter contract.

title: Kit number-field parts should be ut-button instances so a button fragment edit reaches them
body: The nudge, reset parts of ut-number-field are styled by the kit.rcss button rule but are plain divs in number-field.rml, so the live-edit proof (kit/button.rml glyph) changed every ut-button but not the +/- and reset parts. Let fragments instance kit elements (nested registry instancing) or share the button fragment. Tier: luna.

title: Status line shows a stale diagnostic code after the message clears
body: lastEditorDiagnosticCode_ stays RefusedEdit with an empty message after later accepted edits (appflow.read diagnostic {code:RefusedEdit, message:''}). R796 clarity: clear the code with the message. Tier: haiku.

title: Declared-but-unimplemented actions Data and UndoSettingChange show NotImplemented on every editor start
body: R874.3 reports them (status line + channel event) at load, which is correct, but the editor ships two declarations with no handler, so every start opens with a NotImplemented line. Either remove the declarations from the schema or register the handlers. Tier: haiku after an owner choice.

title: HUD view.unfed has no editor consumer: report UIRenderNode::UnfedViewFields once after producers had a frame
body: ViewStore::UnfedFields and UIRenderNode::UnfedViewFields exist and are unit-tested, but no host calls them: the game and the editor load typed views, and the HUD blob path has no reconcile hook to report from. Wire one host call (game app, after the first producer frame) to publish view.unfed. Tier: luna.

title: Kit attribute contract cannot name the line of an offending instance (RmlUi 6.3 has no element source line)
body: UiKit CheckAttributes finds the line by scanning the document text for the first line holding the tag and the attribute name; two instances of one tag with the same bad attribute report the first. Needs RmlUi element source lines or the XML parser handler. Tier: sol.
